interval_years.quote: Licenses shall be renewed every two years upon application and payment of the required fee.

period_years.quote: Licenses shall be renewed every two years upon application and payment of the required fee.

available.quote: The Board may, upon payment of the required fee, license without examination an applicant who presents evidence that he or she: (1) is licensed in another state in which the requirements for licensure are essentially equivalent to those required by this chapter; or (2) holds the certificate of the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting a person known to be unqualified in education, training, or experience to obtain a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: assisting the application for licensure of a person known by the licensee to be unqualified in respect to education, training, or experience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting compensation from more than one party on a project without full disclosure and agreement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepting compensation for services from more than one party on a project unless the circumstances are fully disclosed and agreed to by all interested parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose in writing any business association or financial interest that could influence professional judgment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to disclose fully in writing to a client or employer the nature of any business association or direct or indirect financial interest substantial enough to influence the licensee's judgment in the performance of professional services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting or accepting compensation from material or equipment suppliers in exchange for specifying or endorsing their products.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: soliciting or accepting compensation from material or equipment suppliers in return for specifying or endorsing their products

disciplinary_grounds.description: Rendering decisions favoring either party when acting as interpreter of building contract documents and judge of contract performance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: rendering decisions favoring either party to a contract when acting as interpreter of building contract documents and judge of contract performance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose compensation for making public statements on architectural questions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to disclose compensation for making public statements on architectural questions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering or making payments or gifts to a government official to influence judgment on a project.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: offering or making any payment or gift to an elected or appointed government official with the intent to influence the official's judgment in connection with a prospective or existing project in which the licensee is interested

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering or making gifts of more than nominal value with intent to influence an existing or prospective client's judgment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: offering or making any gifts of other than nominal value, including reasonable entertainment and hospitality, with the intent to influence the judgment of an existing or prospective client in connection with a project in which the licensee is interested

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly designing a project in violation of applicable state and local building laws and regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly designing a project in violation of applicable state and local building laws and regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting responsibilities the licensee knows or has reason to know they are not competent to perform.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepting and performing responsibilities that the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform or undertaking to perform professional services in specific technical areas in which the licensee is not qualified by education, training, and experience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to practice with reasonable care and competence and to apply the technical knowledge and skill ordinarily applied by licensees in the same locality.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to practice with reasonable care and competence and to apply the technical knowledge and skill ordinarily applied by licensees practicing in the same locality

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any willful material misrepresentation regarding the qualifications or experience of an applicant or in the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making any willful material misrepresentation with respect to the qualifications of or experience of an applicant or otherwise in the practice of the profession, whether by commission or omission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Agreeing with any person or subscribing to any code whose intent is to restrict information about unprofessional conduct from reaching the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: agreeing with any other person, as defined in 1 V.S.A. § 128, or subscribing to any code of ethics or organizational bylaws, when the intent or primary effect of that agreement, code, or bylaw is to restrict or limit the flow of information concerning alleged or suspected unprofessional conduct to the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the Board knowledge of a violation of these rules by another licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to report to the Board knowledge of a violation of these rules by another licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the appropriate public official a client or employer decision that violates building laws and will adversely affect public safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to report to the public official charged with enforcement of applicable state or municipal building laws and regulations any decision taken by the licensee's employer or client, against the licensee's advice, which violates applicable state or municipal building laws and regulations and which will, in the licensee's judgment, materially affect adversely safety to the public or the finished project

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as a Board member to willfully contravene the provisions of this chapter and artificially restrict entry of qualified persons into the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: acting, while serving as a Board member, in any way to contravene willfully the provisions of this chapter and thereby artificially restricting the entry of qualified persons into the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the licensee's seal on drawings prepared by others not in the licensee's direct employ, or using the seal of another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using the licensee's seal on drawings prepared by others not in the licensee's direct employ, or using the seal of another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inaccurately representing to a prospective or existing client or employer the licensee's qualifications and scope of responsibility.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: inaccurately representing to a prospective or existing client or employer the licensee's qualifications and scope of responsibility for work for which the licensee claims credit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing or sealing technical submissions not prepared by or under the responsible control of the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: signing or sealing technical submissions unless they were prepared by or under the responsible control of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to have a licensee with direct knowledge and supervisory control resident and regularly employed in each office maintained for preparation of professional work.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: in each office maintained for preparation of drawings, specifications, reports, or other professional work, failing to have a licensee with direct knowledge and supervisory control of such work resident and regularly employed in that office

definition_quote.value: The 'practice of architecture' means providing professional services such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, designing (including structural design), or responsible supervision of construction in connection with any building or structure that has as its principal purpose human occupancy or habitation.
